description: Company enrichment API from a domain — find out what a company is and what it runs. Returns canonical company name, website, description, detected technologies (CMS, e-commerce platform, analytics), social profiles (LinkedIn, X) and mail infrastructure (MX), read live from the website and DNS, so no stale database. Use for lead enrichment, sales research, vendor due diligence and CRM data completion given only a domain like stripe.com. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.
